# Fontivo — Native Desktop Font Manager & 10,939-Font Library

> Fontivo is a free, open-source (MIT) Windows, macOS, and Linux desktop font manager built with Native Rust and React 19, paired with the Fontivo-Fonts v1.0.3 curated typography collection.

## Canonical Releases
- Desktop Application: v1.0.0 (Windows Setup Installer `Fontivo-v1.0-Setup.exe`, 4.01 MB; macOS & Linux native source installer `scripts/install.sh`)
- Fontivo-Fonts Library: v1.0.3 (10,939 unique SHA-256 deduplicated fonts across 4,430 families in 15 modular ZIP packs, 864.01 MB total)
  - Scripts: Latin (7,146), Urdu (1,565), Persian (1,257), Arabic (971)

## Core Capabilities
- In-Memory Font Activation on Windows via Win32 `AddFontResourceExW (FR_PRIVATE)` with zero permanent Windows Registry writes.
- Local Adobe CC Auto-Activation Bridge on `127.0.0.1:27715` for `.PSD`, `.AI`, `.INDD`, and `.PDF`.
- Brand Color Studio with 5x5 loupe picker, live WCAG 2.1 contrast auditing, and binary `.ASE` swatch export.
- 100% local-first, zero telemetry, zero subscriptions.
